closing.title: Closing
closing.subtitle: Checklists, periods and workflow for fiscal year {fy}.
closing.stateHint.TENUE: Day-to-day bookkeeping: entries for the year are posted freely.
closing.stateHint.REVISION: Accounting review: controls, adjustments and closing checklists.
closing.stateHint.ETATS: Financial statements produced: awaiting submission to the reviewer.
closing.stateHint.VISA: Submitted for sign-off by the chartered accountant or the owner.
closing.stateHint.DEPOT: Signed off: to be filed with the tax authority.
closing.stateHint.VERROUILLE: Fiscal year filed and locked: no more entries.
closing.transitionHint.TENUE_REVISION: Move the fiscal year to review: the annual checklist is generated if needed.
closing.transitionHint.REVISION_TENUE: Go back to bookkeeping for corrections. State the reason.
closing.transitionHint.REVISION_ETATS: All blocking controls of the financial statements must pass.
closing.transitionHint.ETATS_VISA: Submit the statements to the person signing them off (OWNER or REVIEWER role).
closing.transitionHint.VISA_REVISION: Reject the statements and go back to review. A comment is expected.
closing.transitionHint.VISA_DEPOT: Separation of duties: the person who produced the statements cannot sign them off.
closing.transitionHint.DEPOT_VERROUILLE: The filing receipt document id (tax authority) is required; the fiscal year becomes permanently locked.
closing.workflow.title: Fiscal-year workflow
closing.workflow.hint: Bookkeeping → Review → Statements → Sign-off → Filing → Locked.
closing.workflow.receiptHint: Id of the document stored in the document module.
closing.controls.title: Blocking controls
closing.controls.hint: Failing financial-statement controls; they block the Review → Statements step.
closing.lock.confirm: Permanently lock fiscal year {fy}? Every period becomes locked.
closing.lock.hint: Irreversible: no entry or unlock will be possible afterwards.
closing.lock.hintShort: Open periods: {open}. Locking is reserved to OWNER and REVIEWER roles.
closing.periods.title: Periods
closing.periods.hint: Monthly close: the period checklist must be complete. Unlocking requires a comment and a distinct approver.
closing.periods.empty: No period for this fiscal year.
closing.periods.closeHint: Blocking items of the monthly checklist must be handled.
closing.periods.closeLastHint: Last period: closing it is the annual close (annual checklist and controls required).
closing.unlock.separation: Separation of duties: the unlock is logged with the requester (you) and a different approver with the OWNER or REVIEWER role. The API rejects an approver identical to the requester.
closing.unlock.approverHint: Must differ from your own id.
closing.unlock.errorComment: The reason must be at least 5 characters.
closing.unlock.errorSelf: The approver must differ from the requester.
closing.checklist.monthlyHint: Per period: reconciliations, VAT, payroll… Tick each item with its evidence.
closing.checklist.none: Checklist not generated for this period.
